title: U-Con 2018 Final: Summon Young Witch, Procession, Raze bane, Colonies

sources.author: Adam Horton
sources.note: Michigan U-Con 2018 Tournament Summary; Set 2018-F (final), Horton won

quality_note: Horton's reasoned plan (Summon Young Witch going first, spam and trash Razes, Procession chains, 3-pile) won the final, though he credits first-player advantage.

kingdom.setup_notes: Tournament rule (U-Con): players may arrange their starting decks, so they choose a 4/3 or 5/2 opening. 3-player game. Raze is the Young Witch Bane. The 2018 versions of Procession and Prince could also use Duration cards, and Band of Misfits was not a Command.

edition: Pre-errata Procession, Prince and Band of Misfits.
